Composition rights
Underlying composition is out of copyright where the ordinary life-plus-70 term applies. Inferred, not documented

The composer died in 1934. This is a term calculation, not a worldwide clearance or a statement about an unidentified modern edition.

[5] [6]
Recording rights
Territorial sound-recording public-domain claim: PD-EU-audio; eligible under the programme’s European historical-recording rule. Documented

The recording-specific Licensing section says European performers’ and producers’ rights have expired. The structured CC0 claim is not treated as a waiver by the original commercial rights holder. This is territorial, not a worldwide licence; US sound-recording status is not established. The attributed 1947 recording year is not represented as an independently verified first-publication date.

  • PD-EU-audio — European performers’ and producers’ rights claimed expired.
  • CC0 — dedication asserted by Commons Structured data.
